description: A major non-conformity creates a significant immediate risk to information security or creates doubts regarding the overall effectiveness of the information security management system; examples are systematic non-conformities and implementation deficits that create critical risks to the security of confidential information or that are not addressed by an appropriate corrective action
auditor_comment: The participant has to address major non-conformities immediately with appropriate compensating measures and implement corrective actions without undue delay

description: A minor non-conformity does not create a significant immediate risk to information security and does not create doubts regarding the overall effectiveness of the information security management system; examples are isolated or sporadic mistakes and non-compliance or deficits in the implementation of requirements or the participant's own policies
auditor_comment: The participant has to implement corrective actions without undue delay

description: An observation is a non-compliance with the requirements or the participant's own policies that does not create an immediate risk to information security but may do so in the future
auditor_comment: The participant has to carefully investigate; monitor and evaluate possible risks and decide how to handle the observation

description: A deviation that does not belong to the aforementioned types and does not create a risk to information security yet offers obvious room for improvement
auditor_comment: The participant can decide whether or how to address this type of finding
